Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the chase! The two umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. Ayush Mhatre and Vaibhav Suryavanshi will open the innings for India Under-19. Ali Raza will be getting the duty the start with the new ball for Pakistan Under-19. Away we go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

India Under-19 did not have the best of starts with the ball but they pulled things nicely in the last 20 overs and kept Pakistan Under-19 under 300 which at one stage looked fairly easy for the Pakistan Under-19. Samarth Nagaraj was the pick of the bowlers with a fine spell of 3 for 45 while Ayush Mhatre chipped in with a couple of wickets. Yudhajit Guha and Kiran Chormale with one apiece were tidy in their effort. India Under-19 needs 282 to win and start their competition with a win. Can they do it or will Pakistan Under-19 defend their score? We shall find out soon. Join us in a while for the second essay.

A solid batting effort from Pakistan Under-19 helps them get to an excellent score of 281in their 50 overs. Opting to bat first after winning the toss, the Pakistan Under-19 openers batted well and added 160 for the opening wicket. Usman Khan made a steady 60 but it was the terrific knock of 159 from Shahzaib Khan that took the total beyond 280. Riaz Ullah chipped in with a handy 27 but the middle and lower-order batters lost their wickets quickly and Pakistan Under-19 failed to get the desired finish. Nonetheless, they have runs on the board and the team will be confident of defending it.
